name: proj-pre-mortem
description: Runs a pre-mortem for a project team and produces the Pre-Mortem Analysis, with grouped failure reasons, the top five turned into owned risks and the plan changes to make now. Use for "run proj-pre-mortem", "pre-mortem", "premortem", "imagine the project failed", "what could kill this project", "risks nobody says out loud", "facilitate a pre-mortem session", "failure brainstorm before launch", part of the AI for Project Management Pack by 90n.
